heading: Pets I’ve loved & looked after
intro: A few of the dogs and cats I’ve had the joy of walking, feeding, and spoiling over the years.
note: Caring for children is every bit as central to what I do — I just keep the little ones’ photos private out of respect for their families. So here, it’s the wagging tails and whiskers I get to show off.
